entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aulus Cornelius Palma Frontonianus was a soldier and Roman statesman who was twice consul: first as consul ordinarius in AD 99, with Quintus Sosius Senecio as his colleague; and again in 109, with Publius Calvisius Tullus Ruso as his colleague.
